title: a crossing made by a sail verb leaves its component's history and state committed, so no record of truth lives on one disk
intention: After sail.py cross or sail.py verdict returns, the crossed component's history.json and state.json are committed, path-limited to that crossing's own records, so a crossing never exists only as uncommitted dirt on one disk.
why: Measured 2026-11-19 on akiendell: five crossings stood only as uncommitted dirt in the house tree until landed by hand on akiendell-1eee-fixme-record (0065e73b6): tester seq 408 (1eeeab70c59e PROVEME->FIXME), codemother seq 172 (35bb99574043 PROVEME->FIXME), verdict seq 32 (8e0cfb77827c PROVEME->FIXME), chart_gate seq 9 (7cae18f7f9c2 TICKETME->BUILDME) and seq 10 (c1a7130fba84 TICKETME->SUPERSEDED). Read: projector.append_entry writes history and state and runs no git; the Stop and PostToolUse hooks in .claude/settings.json commit nothing; the only committer of a crossing's records is close.sh's commit_all, which runs at close or prove, and a verdict refusal or a supersede never reaches it. Law 7: a crossing on one disk is not permanent.
traces_to: Law 7 (permanent in records of truth); Law 4 (physics, not a hand remembering sail step 10); Law 5 (the repo is itself the state of the machine).
how: A hypothesis, measured by the proof: the sail verbs commit the crossed component's own history.json and state.json path-limited after the crossing lands, mirroring close.sh's commit_all but staging only that crossing's paths; or a check reds a crossing whose records are dirty after the verb returns. The build measures which seam, and records it.

clauses.claim: after sail.py cross lands a crossing in a scratch repo, the component's history.json and state.json are committed and git status of those paths is clean
after sail.py verdict refuses a ticket to FIXME, the same two files are committed, not left dirty
another ticket's dirty records in the same tree are not staged or committed by the crossing

decisions.text: D1: the sail verbs commit the crossed component's history.json and state.json path-limited after the crossing returns; the build records whether the seam is the verb or a red check.
D2: the red-first proof drives a scratch crossing through each verb, one tooth per clause, PROVES declared.

measured.saw: five crossings (tester seq 408, codemother seq 172, verdict seq 32, chart_gate seq 9 and 10) uncommitted in the akiendell house tree; projector.append_entry has no git call; no Stop/PostToolUse hook commits; close.sh commit_all is the only committer
measured.how: git status and git diff of the house tree on 86cc-red-first-proof, verify_crossing_fingerprint on each entry, grep of projector.py and .claude/settings.json hooks, read of close.sh
